title: How would you validate a trading agent before putting $100K behind it?
author: orid7
selftext:
Every time someone shares their bot's results, the replies are the same: backtest, cherry picked, paper account, show the losses.   
Most of the time that is fair, and it is also why nobody puts money behind these bots.

I have the same problem with mine.

The only fix I can think of: run the bot somewhere that locks the strategy so it can't quietly change, records every trade as it happens.   
The ones that hold up for long enough get verified and real capital behind them. 

Also, if it was your bot, would you let a third party host it to get a verified badge and a shot at funding?
